quote: After going undrafted in the 2017 NBA draft, Mathiang played for the Charlotte Hornets during the 2017 NBA Summer League.
On 2 August 2017, he signed a two-way contract with the Hornets.
He spent most of his time in the G League.
He was waived by the Hornets on 15 August 2018.
On 22 August 2018, Mathiang signed with Vanoli Cremona of the Lega Basket Serie A.
On 11 July 2019, Mathiang signed with Bahçeşehir Koleji of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL).
Mathiang was set to play for Cedevita Olimpija of the ABA League in the 2020–21 season, but later missed the whole season
He re-signed with Cedevita Olimpija in May 2021, but was let go in August 2021 after the injury worsened.
After a four-game stint with the Casey Cavaliers of the NBL1 South during the 2022 NBL1 season, Mathiang signed
Mathiang signed with the Illawarra Hawks of the National Basketball League on 29 July 2022.
He parted ways with the Hawks on 26 January 2023 to take up a playing opportunity overseas.
He averaged 7.7 points, 5.1 rebounds, and 1.0 blocks (6th in the league) in 25 games during the 2022–23 NBL season.
On 29 January 2023, Mathiang signed with Hapoel Eilat of the Israeli Basketball Premier League.
On 13 June 2023, Mathiang signed with the New Zealand Breakers for the 2023–24 NBL season.
On 11 March 2024, Mathiang signed with Maccabi Ironi Ramat Gan of the Israeli Basketball Premier League.
On 26 September 2024, Mathiang signed with the Ningbo Rockets of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA).
In April 2025, Mathiang joined the Daegu KOGAS Pegasus of the Korean Basketball League (KBL) for the 2025 playoffs,
He returned to Daegu for the 2025–26 season but was released in late October 2025.
In December 2025, Mathiang joined the Beijing Ducks of the Chinese Basketball Association.
In March 2026, Mathiang had a one-game stint with APR BBC of the Rwanda Basketball League.
Later that month, he joined RSSB Tigers for the 2026 BAL season.
